steps.title: Find a zombie villager
steps.say: It looks like a [zombie](mob:zombie) with a villager nose and clothes. They come out at night.

steps.title: Trap it in the shade
steps.say: [Lead](item:lead) it into a hole or a room with a roof, so it can not reach you and sunlight can not burn it.

steps.title: Make a weakness potion
steps.say: Brew a water bottle with a [fermented spider eye](item:fermented_spider_eye). Add [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to make it a [splash potion](item:splash_potion).

steps.title: Throw it
steps.say: Throw the [splash potion](item:splash_potion) of weakness at the zombie villager.

steps.title: Feed it a golden apple
steps.say: Right away, use a [golden apple](item:golden_apple) on it. Use a plain one, not an enchanted one.

steps.title: Wait
steps.say: It starts to shake. After 3 to 5 minutes it turns back into a villager.

steps.title: Get a thank-you
steps.say: A villager you cured gives you lower prices when you trade.
